title: Prospective Selector-Discrimination and Intervention-Activation Corrective Protocol Freeze

inherited_scientific_finding.interpretation: v0.34 established material counterfactual-target signal and nonzero selector optimization, but did not establish meaningful selector-output discrimination. Intervention activation was absent. Under the frozen v0.34 localization ordering, the primary localized failure is selector discrimination; v0.34 did not independently establish activation-mapping failure.

corrective_scope.primary_objective: Prospectively identify and implement the minimum scientifically justified correction needed for the selector to produce meaningfully discriminative utility outputs.
corrective_scope.secondary_objective: After selector discrimination is established under prospectively frozen criteria, determine whether the existing downstream activation mapping produces nonzero intervention.
non_objectives: re-argue the frozen v0.34 M1/M2 findings
repair or rewrite the frozen v0.34 record
select a correction using official-test outcomes
silently change corruption or quality conditions

causal_investigation_order.name: selector_output_path_audit
causal_investigation_order.question: Does the implemented selector output path contain a structural or numerical compression mechanism capable of explaining the frozen low utility-probability variance?

causal_investigation_order.name: objective_to_output_coupling_audit
causal_investigation_order.question: Given the inherited nonzero optimization signal, does the selector objective provide sufficient coupling to move utility outputs away from near-neutral compression?

causal_investigation_order.name: minimal_corrective_design
causal_investigation_order.question: What is the minimum correction justified by D1/D2 without broad architecture redesign?
causal_investigation_order.rule: Correction must be causally tied to the prospectively audited discrimination mechanism and must be frozen before corrective training.

causal_investigation_order.name: post_correction_discrimination_adjudication
causal_investigation_order.question: After prospectively authorized corrective training, does selector-output discrimination satisfy the separately frozen v0.35 success criterion?
causal_investigation_order.rule: Criterion and evidence boundary must be frozen before corrective training.

causal_investigation_order.name: downstream_activation_adjudication
causal_investigation_order.question: Only if D4 supports restored discrimination, does the existing downstream activation mapping produce nonzero intervention?
causal_investigation_order.rule: Failure of D5 after successful D4 may motivate a separately localized activation-mapping investigation; D5 must not be interpreted before D4.

prospective_success_contract.inherited_reference: The v0.34 M3 threshold was utility_probability_std >= 0.05 for every formal seed.
prospective_success_contract.rule: Step1 preserves the inherited 0.05 discrimination threshold as the default reference and prohibits weakening it. Before any v0.35 corrective training, a later protocol step must freeze the exact v0.35 training design, seeds, observability, and success/adjudication contract.
prospective_success_contract.anti_relaxation: No v0.35 protocol may lower the inherited selector-discrimination threshold merely because v0.34 failed it.
prospective_success_contract.activation_reference: The inherited v0.34 M4 criterion required active_intervention_rate > 0 for every formal seed.
prospective_success_contract.ordering: Discrimination must be adjudicated before downstream activation is interpreted as an independent mechanism result.

version_integrity.v035_changes: MUST OCCUR ONLY ON V0.35 BRANCH

required_next_step.title: Prospective Selector Discrimination Failure-Mechanism Audit Protocol
required_next_step.purpose: Freeze the exact read-only code/configuration audit questions, admissible source files, evidence outputs, and decision rules for D1/D2 before inspecting or modifying the selector implementation.

prohibitions: no modification of frozen v0.34 artifacts
no v0.35 corrective implementation in Step1
no additional training seeds in Step1
no weakening of the inherited selector-discrimination threshold based on v0.34 failure
no broad architecture or loss redesign without a prospectively frozen causal justification
no new corruption or quality conditions
no interpretation of M4 as independently proving activation-mapping failure while M3 remains unresolved
no use of future v0.35 results to rewrite this Step1 protocol
